notes.title: Super Sami Roll 2 Kickstarter Campaign Just Launched!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39888328/03467010feeaa157b63a77a5ea34a2b2414cc450.png[/img]
The day we've all been waiting for is finally here...

[h2]The Kickstarter campaign for Super Sami Roll 2 has officially launched![/h2]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sonzaigames/super-sami-roll-2 ]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sonzaigames/super-sami-roll-2 [/url]

There's plenty to be excited about for Sami's upcoming sequel, and we've made sure to highlight all of the best bits on our Kickstarter. Check out the campaign and let us know if there's anything else you would like to know in the coming weeks!

We have [b]30 days to raise approximately US$15,000[/b], so please consider supporting us and helping us get the word out as much as you can! There's some fun stretch goals that we'd love to tell you more about during the campaign, but that completely depends on how soon we can cross our funding goal.

Super Sami Roll 2 will be [b]coming to PC and all consoles[/b], so no one will miss out on experiencing it at launch. Backing the game will guarantee you a copy on the platform of your choice when it releases. We even have a limited number of early bird discounts for our most loyal fans, but be quick, as these may not last long!

Our Kickstarter campaign even includes some [b]social goals[/b] with their own set of rewards. Please consider helping with these if you've already backed the game, as there are some really fun features that you can help bring to the game without any extra funding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39888328/5ac565a5e8e561dea2331452d1951fc5c5ca5dbd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39888328/12764f5016b3d5b5e907789a83c7122690a3004f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39888328/bea26a170a4135267ab5ae9148620fb9259d40ce.gif[/img]

Want to check out the game for yourself? Our demo available on Steam will remain active throughout the entire campaign. Enjoy the first 5 opening levels of the game and get a first glimpse at our vision for the sequel.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237190 ]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237190 [/url]

[b]Thank you to anyone who helps make Super Sami Roll 2 a reality![/b]

notes.title: Super Sami Roll 2 is now in development!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=oqk8IVZIDYQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Let me preface this by thanking everyone who decided to give the original Super Sami Roll a chance. You all are the reason why the sequel is now in development.

All feedback from the original game, good and not so good, has been taken into account to ensure Super Sami Roll 2 is the best game possible!

What can you expect in Super Sami Roll 2, you ask?
[list]
[*] [b]Better graphics[/b] (I guess this goes without saying)
[*] [b]New exciting and colorful environments[/b] you'll want to return to
[*] [b]Several playable characters[/b] with distinct abilities
[*] [b]Customizable outfits[/b] for the main characters (of course!)
[*] [b]Accessibility options[/b] to make sure that everybody has an awesome time!
[*] [b]Secrets![/b] Tons of them
[*] [b]Returning of Evader Music[/b] for an amazing upbeat soundtrack
[*] And much more!
[/list]
[b]Wishlist [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2798320]Super Sami Roll 2 on Steam[/url]

I'm also preparing a Kickstarter campaign for those who want to support the development and get some cool rewards in the process! (Including a copy of the game at a cheaper cost than it will be at launch).

[b]Follow [/b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sonzaigames/super-sami-roll-2]Super Sami Roll 2 on Kickstarter[/url] so you are notified when the campaign is ready.

If you want to also get the smaller updates, you can follow the development on Twitter/X:
[url=https://twitter.com/SuperSamiRoll]https://twitter.com/SuperSamiRoll[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/SonzaiGames]https://twitter.com/SonzaiGames[/url]

And join the official [url=https://discord.gg/UjqssfJK5U]Super Sami Roll Discord[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/WfbSsv4DUE]Sonzai Games Discord[/url].

The planned release for the game is 2025, but being a small studio, this will largely depend on how the Kickstarter campaign goes.
The original Super Sami Roll game was a game developed by a single person (myself). For this sequel I hope to have more hands on deck to speed up the process and offer even higher quality.

- Venox
Sonzai Games

notes.title: Super Sami Roll gets its first collab With Dragon Drop!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone! So a little while ago, the fine folks at [i]Cloudy Games LLC[/i] 
reached out to us about how the heck we could get their awesome little 
dragon characters working with our little lizard character.
Well after much brainstorming and many sleepless caffeinated nights, 
we’re happy to announce that [i]Sami[/i] will be getting a [i]Dragon Drop[/i] 
themed….*drumroll*....*pause for effect*...HAT!


Haha! Yeah, we know it’s just a little thing for now but doesn’t it 
look cute on Sami? No doubt we’ll venture into other collab territory with 
other awesome games in the future, but for now, you can enjoy rolling 
around [i]Super Sami Roll’s[/i] many stages wearing this neat little head-piece proudly! 
The collab DLC is now live as of 17:30!

While you’re at it, make sure to show [i]Dragon Drop[/i] by [i]Cloudy Games LLC[/i] 
some love and check the game out at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1581500/Dragon_Drop/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1581500/Dragon_Drop/[/url]. 
It’s an awesome 4 player party game that’s perfect for couch co-op 
and offers a ton of excitement, not to mention customization options. 
A perfect reason to Wishlist, don't ya think?
You may even see a familiar bit of headwear from their side too...
[/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
- Added 2 missing colliders to rocks in stage 3-1.
- Reduced voice volume for Sami in tower of chaos level intros.
- Fixed bug where the sounds coming from the enemy Pirakana would not be affected by the settings preferred volume.
- Fixed bug where the a particular screen effect coming from the use of an accessory would not work during boss fights.
- Fixed accessory visual glitch.
- Added Dragon Drop! hat to the game.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
- Fixed bug where the boss in World 3 would sometimes play the wrong animation.
- Fixed bug where the player would collide with an invisible wall near the second tree of stage 1-3.
- Fixed bug where grappling into "hangpoles" or "hangbats" very quickly twice in a row would make Sami get frozen in the air.
- Fixed small visual glitch on a shadow on stage 1-6 when playing on low quality settings.
- Made sure that all rotating objects in stage 5-5 get reset to their original rotation every time the stage is restarted.
- Fixed bug where Sami would go inside the wall at the very end of stage 5-2.
- Fixed wrong shadow at the start of stage 1-8 when playing as Sami.
- Slightly moved jump bumper on stage 4-S1 to facilitate a very tricky jump.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
- Fixed bug where using the stomp ability on sand would cause the player to not be able to perform a full jump the following seconds
- Fixed teleport orientation in stage 2-11
- Fixed bug where the music could be heard even when setting the volume to 0
- Improved collision detection when using jump bumpers in stage 4-13
- Fixed bug where using the stomp ability in a specific spot of stage 4-6 could cause the player to go through the floor
- Fixed bug where using the stomp ability the same frame the players enters a pipe could block the usage of the stomp until the stage is restarted

notes.title: Patch 1.1.9
notes.content:
- Fix for an invisible chip (a.k.a. coin) in stage 2-3
- Removed invisible area that would instantly kill the player in stage 1-5
- Fixed bug where clearing a stage for the first time using a secret exit while also collecting the raspberry for the first time in that stage, would not show the raspberry as collected in the map afterwards
- Fixed bug where the clear time would not be saved in stage 5-5 when cleared for the second time
- Added new sound effect for jumping while using Sami

notes.title: Patch 1.1.8
notes.content:
- Improved voice lines for Sami
- Fixed bug that prevented the achievement "Expert Fruit Collector" from being accessed under certain conditions

notes.title: Patch 1.1.7
notes.content:
- Changed required time for Maestro rank on stage 3-8. It is easier now
- Fixed issue in stage 3-8 where the sound played when the raspberry spawns would be too loud
- Fixed issue in stage 4-13 where it was possible to tongue-grapple the lava waves

notes.title: Patch 1.1.6
notes.content:
Content:

- Moving platforms in stage 3-7 now reset to a fixed position when the stage gets restarted
- Fixed text label in options menu that would show a wrong value when the language is changed
- Fixed an issue where zooming in and out constantly would cause the skybox to show glitched graphics
- Fixed issue where the player could get an undesired push force if they restarted the stage at the same frame they interacted with certain objects
- Fixed issue in stage 2-4 where colliding with spikes could cause the player to be pushed upwards at double the speed it should
- Fixed issue where using the grappling tongue while falling straight down could cause the tongue to target the wrong spot
- Fixed issue where repeteadly restart any of the tower levels during the animation intro could cause a particle effect to duplicate several times
- Fixed visual glitch where one of the panels of the UI when entering a stage would be shown at quite low resolution
- Optimized lava shader for some levels
- Fixed visual glitch on animated small plants in stage 1-14

notes.title: Patch 1.1.5 is live now!
notes.content:
Content:

- Fixed issue where Speedrun mode would not spawn checkpoints when it should
- Fixed bug where playing Speedrun mode and then entering Vera's Quest mode would make it so the player controls Sami instead of Vera.
- Fixed bug in Speedrun mode where Yukiko would sometimes not appear when restarting from a checkpoint.
- Fixed bug where stomp would stop working if pressed the same frame the ledge climbing animation is triggered.
- Fixed odd collision in a collider on stage 1-11.
- Fixed bug where the controls on stage 1-5 when using mouse and keyboard would behave like if the camera is locked.
- Fixed bug where the chips spawned after hitting a tree would still be granted to the player even if the stage is restarted.
- Fixed visual glitch when pressing stomp and restarting the stage immediately.
- Fixed bug where the timer of a stage would not stop immediately as soon as the goal is reached.
- Fixed bug where jumping would get double the force if the button is the pressed the same frame the tongue starts grappling.
- Fixed bug where jumping would get double the force if pressing the jump button 2 consecutive frames.
- Fixed bug where 2 chip coins in stage 1-15 were invisible.
- Performance improvements in several stages.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.4
notes.content: Fixed audio issue originated in patch 1.1.3.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3 is here!
notes.content:
List of changes:

- New difficulty mode "Relaxed". The time limit in levels has been removed to allow for more stress-free gameplay sessions.
- Fix on stage 4-13 where a jump bumper would not work in some cases.
- Added missing collider in stage 1-4.
- Fixed animation issue when using grappling tongue the same frame Sami transitions back to its Idle animation.
- Fixed issue where Sami would not hug a wall if the jump button is being held down.
- In stage 3-7, changed rotating bumpers so they reset to the same position on stage restart.
- Fixed issue where pressing the jump button the same frame the tongue starts grappling could cause a jump bigger than usual.
- Fixed a couple of wrong interactions when entering a pipe using the grappling tongue.
- Fixed collider issue in stage 2-s1.
- Fixed issue when pressing the stomp button the same frame that Sami hugs a wall would cause the stomp to stop working.
- Fixed a couple of issues related to Speedrun mode.
- Fixed achievement unlock.
- Enemy position change in stage 4-11.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 is live now!
notes.content:
Hello there!

 

Some more fixes added to the game:

Fixed bug where using the grappling tongue just one frame before clearing a stage would cause the wrong animation to play.
Fixed bug where, right after using the stomp skill, the grappling tongue and stomp would not work until restarting the stage.
Fixed bug where using the grappling tongue just before entering a vertical pipe would cause Sami to lose speed within the pipe.
Fixed bug where the stomp skill would not work properly if the jump button was pressed at the same time.
Fixed bug where Sami would keep moving during the stage clear animation.
Fixed bug where the fast-forward functionality on the stage intro would not work right after changing difficulty.
Fixed a couple of typos in the English localization.
Fixed bug where some enemies rotation would appear to be wrong while the game is paused.
Fixed bug where Vera glide skill would be triggered with the LB button.
Moved enemy position in stage 4-13 to make it a bit easier to pass through it.

 

If you know about any other issues let us know!

notes.title: Super Sami Roll is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Super Sami Roll is now available on Steam![/h1]

Today is a very exciting time for both us at [b]XPLUS Games[/b] and no doubt for [b]Sonzai Games[/b] too. After 3 years of development [b]Super Sami Roll[/b] is finally available to the public!

We hope everyone enjoys this love letter to the addictive rolling platformers of the late 90s/early 00s!
Sonzai Games did a tremendous job in hitting all of those familiar highs, speeding along roadways, the tense moments of teetering on course edges or wobbling precariously along narrow beams trying to get the all important collectible.

There are a lot of cool little surprises in store as well for those particularly savvy explorers! Make sure to leave no stone unturned, but just make sure you keep an eye on the time.

Speaking of time, while you may find the game to be devilishly challenging later on, the developer at Sonzai Games knows not everyone works well under pressure. So if you need it, there's a consumable in the store that turns off the dreaded timer if you just want to make your way through the stages without worry.

Though that's all the help we're offering up! You'll just have to play and learn it's tricks yourself! :)

Oh yeah, and don't forget to send us your best stage-clear times! We'd love to see how quick you're making it through some of the trickier stages! 

You can find us on [b]Discord[/b] at:
https://discord.gg/PGqtuvr

And [b]Twitter[/b] at:
https://twitter.com/XPlusGames

Take care for now!

X PLUS Games & Sonzai Games

notes.title: Super Sami Roll Releases on July 21st!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

While we may have blasted much of the news out on our social media platforms, we wanted to reach out to you all personally here to proudly announce that Super Sami Roll will be releasing on [b]July 21st 2021 at 4pm PDT / July 22nd 2021 at 8am JST![/b]  Not long now! A couple of sleeps to go and you'll be ready to play what is one of the most addicting 3D platformers ever! We'll also be launching the game at a 34% discount until July 28th, so don't delay!

[h2][h3]So here's a little run down of what to expect![/h3][/h2]

[i]In Super Sami Roll, you need to get through 12 fun-filled hours of content to help Sami rescue his friend Vera from a meanie who calls himself “Albert VII.” Cruise past beautiful green fields, deserts dotted with magnificent pyramids, dangerous oozing volcanoes, frigid ice lands, and many other memorable places to take Albert VII down a peg ... or two (yep, Albert V sounds about right!). Grappling hooks? That’s so 2020. In this game, you get a grappling tongue to get out of sticky situations![/i]

[h3]Key Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Picturesque world: Explore eye-catching environments and meet memorable characters.
[*] Level variety: Play through dozens upon dozens of unique levels!
[*] 2D and 3D: Painstakingly hand-crafted pixel art meets modern 3D graphics.
[*] Secrets galore: Tons of secrets – including awesome unlockables like a multiplayer mode!
[*] Easy to learn, tough to master: Progressive difficulty with a hearty challenge.
[*] Sami in style: Customize your character to your heart’s content.
[*] Musical delights: Upbeat soundtrack
[/list]

[h3]Here's what [i]Sergio Matta[/i], creator of [i]Super Sami Roll[/i] and founder of [i]Sonzai Games[/i] had to share about his new creation:[/h3]

“With Super Sami Roll, I wanted to create a game that brings back the ‘warm and fuzzy’ feeling we all experienced back in the ‘90s (and early '00s) playing 3D platformers – particularly the rolling kind. However, I wanted more than to simply pay homage to a beloved genre. I want to give players something new ... and that’s precisely where the grappling tongue comes in! This core mechanic – plus a living, breathing world filled with personable NPCs – is what makes Super Sami Roll so special.”


[h3]We hope you all enjoy the game and have a wonderful time exploring and discovering it's many secrets![/h3]
